175394.overview: Fantasy Quest is a text adventure for the Oric-1 and Atmos computers. It was developed by HGC Software and published by IJK Software in 1983.

175621.overview:
Frelon is an action game where the player takes control of a helicopter whose task it is to rebuild a bridge. The bridge is needed so that a truck can enter enemy territory. The problem is that the pieces of the bridge are scattered around five interconnected screens that the player has to traverse from a side view perspective. After locating a piece, the player moves over it to pick it up and returns it to the bridge where it is properly put in place. What makes this harder are the enemy forces that do everything they can to stop the player from fulfilling his job.

Planes, tanks, rockets and falling objects are all things that the player has to avoid or shoot down. Crashing into these, the ground or their projectiles will lead to a life being lost. The player also has to watch out for the helicopter's fuel level, or else it might explode. There are nine different difficulty levels to choose from and when one is completed the game automatically moves on to the next one. The game ends after three lives has been lost.

175650.overview: Flight 401? is a civilian flight simulation game, developed and published by KnightSoft, which was released in Europe in 1984.

175659.overview: Frigate Commander is a 1-player naval war strategy game for the Oric-1 and Atmos computers. It was developed and released by IJK Software in 1984.

175854.overview: The football management game style has been one of the most enduring since Kevin Toms pioneered it in 1982. You start in the 4th division with the team of your choice, and can play on indefinitely in the hope of reaching the top division and dominating it, as well as winning the cups. Players can be bought or sold, with their transfer values varying according to the size of any bid. Their skills and morale vary as the season goes on, with resting key players in easy matches often a key move. You can take out a loan, limited depending on your division, while day-to-day bills must be covered. Matches feature short animated highlights sequences of key moments (Text only for C16).

175864.overview: Feasibility Experiment is a text adventure for the Oric-1 and Atmos computers. It was published by both Channel 8 Software and Paxman Productions as a joint production in 1983.

175917.overview: 4 multilanguage educational games for children focusing on math.

175918.overview: Flipper (called Video Flipper on the game's title screen) is a polished pinball game, unique in that it allowed you to alter the physics parameters of the board. Has up to two players.
